title: I Waterproofed Myself With Aerogel!
beats: Is the host safe? Mic demo of metallic ring
Aerogel: lightest solid, great insulator, but brittle (breaks on touch)
Can we keep insulation and gain usability? Paste of particles and binder
Blowtorch on a coated finger; fire at 1500-2000C
Thermal camera shows 907C outside, finger warm
This video: take properties and improve them
Step into pool dry; silvery layer of air
How did I do it? Aerogel particles
Normal silica aerogel is hydrophilic; collapses in water
Why absorbent: huge surface area and OH groups
Physical insecticide, like salt on a slug
Museum cases, Mars InSight vacuum with zeolite aerogel
Replace ~30% OH groups with hydrophobic groups to repel water
Water bounces off; host sprayed, water not touching
Other aerogels: polymers, conductivity trade-offs vs styrofoam

theory: The video shows an extraordinary effect first, then back-fills the mechanism only when the viewer is asking how. The transferable move is spectacle then 'how did I do it', followed by a failure case (the collapsed hydrophilic sample) that motivates the molecular fix.
